title: No Good
text: No Good. I travel a lot and got this for my light clothes,  t-shirts.  Put some in, zipped the bag, picked it up by those cloth handles and one side ripped immediately.  Best go to Walmart ND get cheap duffel bag. This cloth bag is poorly designed and materials are extremely not fit for the bag purpose
